description: The Searle Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in October 1965 as a private limited company and a subsidiary of G.D. Searle & Co., USA, and was converted into a public limited company in November 1993. It is principally engaged in the manufacture of pharmaceutical and other consumer products, and states that it produces both non-pharmaceutical and pharmaceutical brands for consumers under a quality management system certified to ISO-9001. International Brands (Private) Limited is its parent company, holding 56.32% of its shares.
headOffice: One IBL Centre, 2nd Floor, Plot # 1, Block 7 & 8, D.M.C.H.S., Tipu Sultan Road, Off Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, Pakistan
